headline: Premier Energy Secures €850M Financing for Evryo Group Acquisition
summary: Global law firm Greenberg Traurig advised Premier Energy PLC on an €850 million senior facilities agreement to fund its acquisition of Evryo Group, including Distribuție Energie Oltenia.
why: Large utility and energy sector acquisitions involving substantial debt facilities reshuffle corporate footprints and regional market power.

impacts.name: Premier Energy PLC
impacts.why: Acquiring a major utility group expands the company's operational scale and financial obligations.
